reason: The cited evidence supports phonon drag at high strain rates in the Co-containing alloy (E2) and serrations linked to dynamic strain aging (E1, E3), but no evidence directly addresses the effect of Co removal on solute pinning, dynamic strain aging, or the proposed shift in mechanism. The key premise that Co removal reduces pinning and shifts behavior is unsupported by the cited passages.
